parent_evidence: U5.R2R1 D-LUT strong non-affine palette transfer with range/orientation failure
hypothesis: a reference-palette score can provide a strong and reference-sensitive colour direction while a boundary-vanishing stationary flow supplies range, positive orientation and inverse structure
epistemic_scope: analytic synthetic palette-score oracle only; no learned score, image, film stock or operator-identification claim
allowed_actions: implement analytic diagonal-Gaussian-mixture log density and score
map scores to a fixed bounded velocity grid
run synthetic grids twice and write ignored reports
add focused tests and propagate the branch
forbidden_actions: use any image or film pixel
change palette mixtures, cap, grid size, integration steps or gates after results
fit velocity coefficients to a desired output
claim palette density is a film-stock operator

branches.all_gates_pass: open a separately frozen deterministic histogram-to-score ML recovery leaf with synthetic train/confirm palettes and permutation controls
branches.style_or_reference_gate_fails: close palette-score forcing as bland or reference-insensitive without adding ML capacity
branches.structure_gate_fails: close the composition without cap/grid/integration rescue
branches.attraction_gate_fails: close because the safe flow does not preserve the intended palette-score semantics

claim_ceiling: synthetic analytic evidence that a palette-score direction can or cannot be expressed as a strong, distinct, bounded diffeomorphic RGB operator; never learned-ML, image, film-stock, preference, calibration or unpaired-identification evidence
